scope: Actual 128-controller digital component with independent abstract288-bit PHY data interfaces. Raw command bus coincidence audit is not a validated HBM3 DDR command encoder/serializer.

sources.supports: Two pseudo-channels share a command/address/control bus. This HBM2-generation topology does not establish HBM3 DDR command edge occupancy.
Semi-independent pseudo-channels share row/column command buses; alternating pseudo-channel column operations uses the shared interface. Not a license to apply HBM2E timing to HBM3E.
HBM3E provides16 independent channels and32 pseudo-channels. This product page does not provide command DDR edge encoding.
